motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Every hover and state transition (0.25s to 0.45s).

motion.name: served-plate
motion.value: scroll-driven: e1 = easeOutCubic(p / 0.4) turns the plate from -7deg to 0 and scales .95 to 1; e2 = easeOutCubic((p - 0.3) / 0.7) grows a porcelain clip-path circle from the plate edge to 78vmax
motion.purpose: The single signature moment of the opening; off with reduced motion or without JavaScript.

motion.name: phone-bar
motion.value: transform and opacity .35s, visibility switched after
motion.purpose: Bottom phone bar on phones, shown only while no other booking button is on screen.

components.name: Booking Pill
components.description: The primary action everywhere: graded saffron dots leading into a porcelain pill with the phone number.
components.html: Reservar mesa 967 139 381
components.css: .ds-table { background: #1A1617; padding: 32px; } .ds-dots { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; } .ds-dots i { display: block; border-radius: 50%; background: #E2A93B; transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-dots i:nth-child(1){width:15px;height:15px} .ds-dots i:nth-child(2){width:11px;height:11px} .ds-dots i:nth-child(3){width:7.5px;height:7.5px} .ds-dots i:nth-child(4){width:5px;height:5px} .ds-reserve { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; text-decoration: none; color: #201B1C; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-reserve-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; min-height: 56px; padding: 16px 28px; border-radius: 999px; background: #F6F4F1; font: 650 17px/1.4 'Ysabeau Office', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-num { font: 600 18px 'Bodoni Moda', Didot, Georgia, serif; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; } .ds-reserve:hover .ds-reserve-pill { background: #FCFBF9; } .ds-reserve:hover .ds-dots i { transform: scale(1.25); } .ds-reserve:active .ds-reserve-pill { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-reserve:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E2A93B; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-table { background: #1A1617; padding: 32px; } .ds-call { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(243,239,235,.16); color: #F3EFEB; font: 600 16px 'Ysabeau Office', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .25s, background-color .25s; } .ds-call:hover { border-color: #C99580; background: #241E1F; } .ds-call:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E2A93B; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-table { background: #1A1617; padding: 32px; } .ds-lang { display: flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-lang a { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 999px; color: #B8ADAA; font: 600 15px 'Ysabeau Office', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; text-decoration: none; transition: color .25s, background-color .25s; } .ds-lang a:hover { color: #F3EFEB; background: #241E1F; } .ds-lang a[aria-current=page] { color: #E2A93B; } .ds-lang a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E2A93B; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The page is plated the way the Ysconderijo kitchen plates. A night table runs the whole page as its ground; porcelain is where things are read; the logo's oxblood is the charger plate under it all and the field where a table gets booked. Composition sits on one central axis, like the centre line of a plate, with generous dark rim around every element. Ornament is limited to what a chef puts on a plate: graded dots of saffron sauce that lead the eye to the phone number, a single balsamic swoosh, and the copper hairline bands taken from the restaurant's own logo.

The surface alternates between two materials and never mixes them inside one block: dark table (opening, the house, footer), porcelain (the menu), oxblood (booking). Real photographs of the restaurant's food and room are the only pictures, each one framed as a plate: a round well or a capsule. One lit plate per screen; darkness is the space around it. Motion is a single authored moment, the plate being served, and everything else stays still.

The type speaks like a fine-dining menu: a Didone display with hairline contrast (the same fineness as the logo's gold lines), a calligraphic humanist text face, and the script of the logo for the name only.
keyCharacteristics: One central axis; centred headings, left-aligned reading columns hung on it.
Three materials by section: night table, porcelain, oxblood charger.
Saffron dots graded large to small always lead to the booking phone.
Copper three-line bands (from the logo) are the only rules between courses.
Photos sit in round wells or the logo's capsule; nothing else is framed.
Prices and hours in tabular lining figures.

rules.name: The Sauce Leads Rule
rules.body: Saffron appears as graded dots only where they lead somewhere: to the phone, to today, to the open state. It never decorates.

rules.name: The Three Materials Rule
rules.body: A block is table, porcelain or oxblood. Never a porcelain card on the table or an oxblood box on porcelain.

rules.name: The Menu Card Rule
rules.body: Every dish keeps three fixed tiers in the same order in every language: name (Title), what is on the plate (Body, faded ink), price (Title, right column).

rules.name: The Name Is Script Rule
rules.body: Alex Brush sets "Ysconderijo" and nothing else.

rules.name: The Only Shadow Is a Plate Rule
rules.body: If it is not a plate resting on something, it has no shadow.

dos: **Do** lead every booking action with the graded saffron dots, and keep the phone number in Bodoni tabular figures.
**Do** keep each block in one material: table, porcelain or oxblood.
**Do** frame photographs as plates (round well) or in the logo capsule, one per screen.
**Do** use copper three-line bands for rules between courses and around oxblood edges.
**Do** keep text contrast at AA on every material (copper never on porcelain).
donts: **Don't** add cards, tiles or boxed containers; the menu is rows on porcelain.
**Don't** add a second swoosh or scatter sauce dots as decoration.
**Don't** add shadows that are not a plate resting on something.
**Don't** use Alex Brush for anything but the restaurant's name.
**Don't** add a second scroll-driven effect or any infinite animation; the served plate is the only motion moment.
